faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about buying from China with CrossBuy
faq.a1: CrossBuy compares the same product across Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, Pinduoduo and 1688 in a single search, flagging the fastest, cheapest and best-value options.
faq.q2: What is included in the landed price?
faq.a2: Landed price = item price + international shipping + customs duty + VAT + service fee + payment fee, computed in real time under your destination country's tax rules and itemized before checkout — no hidden fees.
faq.q3: Which countries can CrossBuy deliver to?
faq.a3: We ship to the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Canada and more, with multiple carrier options and pre-order price and delivery estimates.
faq.a4: Yes. Items from different platforms are combined into one parcel, shipping is billed on combined weight, and duty-free allowances apply to the merged declared value — usually cheaper than separate shipments.
faq.a5: Economy lines take about 5-10 business days, express lines about 3-7, depending on destination and carrier. Live estimates are shown before you order.
faq.a6: China's domestic prices sit far below overseas retail markups. CrossBuy plugs you directly into source prices and makes shipping and taxes fully transparent, so you decide on the true landed total.
faq.a7: PayPal, Visa, Mastercard and other major international payment methods are supported, with settlement in USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and 20+ currencies. Exchange rates and payment fees are shown transparently before checkout.
faq.q8: How do I track my parcel?
faq.a8: Once your order is picked up, an international tracking number is provided. You can follow both the domestic and cross-border legs in real time on the CrossBuy order page and the carrier's website until delivery.
faq.q9: Can I return or exchange items?
faq.a9: Quality checks are performed before dispatch. If a quality issue is found after delivery, you can request a return or exchange within the allowed window, and our support team helps negotiate with the marketplace seller.
faq.q10: Can I choose the service fee myself?
faq.a10: Yes. The service fee is buyer-selected (0%-30%, default 5%) and shown as a separate line item before checkout; a higher rate means higher service priority.

android.title: Android App
android.desc: APK direct install, works on Android 8.0+
android.step1: Tap the Download button above to get the APK file.
android.step2: Open the file; when asked, allow installs from this source.
android.step3: Tap Install — the CrossBuy icon appears on your home screen.
android.step4: When a new version ships, the app shows an update prompt; tap it to download the new APK.

ios.title: iPhone / iPad
ios.desc: Add to Home Screen via Safari — full App-like experience, auto-updated with the website
ios.guideTitle: Add to Home Screen in 4 steps
ios.step1: Open this site in Safari (iPhone / iPad).
ios.step2: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
ios.step3: Scroll and choose "Add to Home Screen".
ios.step4: Tap Add — CrossBuy runs full-screen from your home screen; updates arrive automatically with the website.

windows.title: Windows App
windows.desc: For Windows 10/11, desktop shortcut with auto update prompt
windows.step1: Download the installer and run it (SmartScreen: click More info → Run anyway).
windows.step2: CrossBuy opens as a desktop app window.

mac.title: macOS App
mac.step1: Unzip the download, then drag CrossBuy.app into Applications.
mac.step2: First launch: right-click the app → Open to bypass Gatekeeper.

upgrade.intro: All desktop and Android app builds include an in-app update check: when a new version ships, you get a prompt with one-tap download. The iOS home-screen app updates itself together with the website.
upgrade.note: When a new version is available, the app shows an update prompt — follow it to get the latest build.
